findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Inspector observed a hand washing sink blocked by food trays. CORRECTED- the person in charge (PIC) moved the trays. Ensure handwashing sinks are available for use at all times to incentivize hand washing.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. [Pf]

findings.title: Food handler training
findings.comment:
Inspector observed a food handler who did not have a Food Handler Certificate. The PIC stated the employee has been here for 7 months. Ensure all employees who are handling or preparing food/ drinks at the facility obtain a Food Handler’s Certificate from an accredited institute within 30 days of hire. 

410 ILCS 625/3.06(b). Food handler training: restaurants. (b) Unless otherwise provided, all food handlers employed by a restaurant, other than someone holding a food service sanitation manager certificate, must receive or obtain American National Standards Institute-accredited training in basic safe food handling principles within 30 days after employment and every 3 years thereafter. Notwithstanding the provisions of Section 3.05 of this Act, food handlers employed in nursing homes, licensed day care homes and facilities, hospitals, schools, and long-term care facilities must renew their training every 3 years. There is no limit to how many times an employee may take the training. The training indicated in subsections (e) and (f) of this Section is transferable between employers, but not individuals. The training indicated in subsections (c) and (d) of this Section is not transferable between individuals or employers. Proof that a food handler has been trained must be available upon reasonable request by a State or local health department inspector and may be provided electronically. [C]

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
Staff could not locate the facility’s probe thermometer. Ensure a probe thermometer is always available in the kitchen for use monitoring both hot and cold food temperatures. A probe thermometer was ordered during this inspection.
4-302.12: (A) FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of FOOD temperatures. (B) A TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE with a suitable small diameter probe that is designed to measure the temperature of thin masses shall be provided and readily accessible to accurately measure the temperature in thin FOODS such as MEAT patties and FISH filets. [Pf]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Caulk along the back of the countertop has separated from the wall. Clean and recaulk the countertop to the wall.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
One spray bottle of blue liquid observed near the laundry area and 3 compartment sink without any label indicating contents. CORRECTED- Bottle was labeled to indicate contents.
7-102.11: Working containers used for storing POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS such as cleaners and SANITIZERS taken from bulk supplies shall be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material. [Pf]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
Food debris observed on the interior of the microwave. Clean microwave.
4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. [C]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: Damp mop was stored in the water compartment of the mop bucket. Storage options were discussed. Store mops so they can air dry.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.16 After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies. [C]

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text:
5-205.11 Basin of designated handwashing sink in the kitchen had a pitcher and metal spoon in it. Items were removed. Ensure proper use and accessibility of handwashing sink during all hours of operation.
Handwashing sinks are to be accessible at all times and used only for handwashing.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.citation_text:
4-203.11 Metal stem thermometer available for checking food temperatures was reading around 50F at room temperature. Thermometer was checked using ice point method and observed reading around 20F. Thermometer was calibrated to 32F in ice water solution. Cleaning and maintenance of food thermometers were discussed. 
Food temperature measuring devices that are scaled only in Fahrenheit shall be accurate to ±2F in the intended range of use.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14 Quat test kit was not available. Assistant director just ordered test strips recently after the facility ran out. Director plans to contact inspector once quat test kit is available.
A test kit that accurately measures the concentration of sanitizing solutions in mg/L shall be provided.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.16 Damp mops were stored in the mopsink basin and the storage compartment of the mop bucket. Storage options were discussed. Admin staff intend to get a rack installed for proper storage. 
After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to air-dry without soiling walls, equipment, or supplies.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.12 Mopsink was soiled with general buildup in the basin, and some splash buildup was present on the walls. Clean the mopsink and walls at the mopsink as daily/as needed.
Physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text:
6-501.11 The base of the cabinet beneath the two basin sink in the kitchen had a warped spot in the middle. It appeared to be from moisture possibly from leaks and wetness from chemicals stored in the cabinet. The plumbing was in good repair and not observed leaking at the time of inspection. Provide repairs to the cabinet under the two basin sink.

-Drain cover was off in the basin of the mopsink. Ensure the cover stays on the drain to prevent debris from entering the plumbing. 
Physical facilities shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16 Fridge in infant room 1 and formula inside were observed at 52°F-54°F. A thermometer was not inside the fridge to verify temperature. Owner provided a thermometer, and inspector placed two thermometers inside to monitor temperature. The thermostat in the fridge was observed at 1 and was adjusted to the coldest setting of 7. Within the half hour the temperature of the unit dropped to 40°F to allow for proper cold holding of formula.

Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as a public health control, cold TCS foods shall be maintained at 41°F/below

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text:
750.810 - Spray bottle in 3s room had a wiping cloth stored with it. Teacher in that room was advised on use of disposable paper towels with spray bottles of sanitizer. If wiping cloths are in use, they must be stored submerged in a sanitizer solution between uses.

Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.citation_text:
750.540 - None of the staff working at the time of inspection had a current food manager certification. Director just completed online course work as of 3/9/18 and is scheduled to take the test at PSI next week. Contact inspector with certification number and expiration date once certificate is received (see general comments)


Category I facilities must employ an adequate number of licensed certified food managers to have one present at all times food is being prepared to help ensure proper food handling.  Provide an adequate number of certified food managers.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.citation_text:
750.1320 - Spray bottles of sanitizer were +400ppm quat in all spray bottles. The solutions were all a dark blue color, and the test strips registered off the chart in strength. Solutions were diluted to be at 200-400ppm per the label instructions. Make sure staff are using test strips to verify concentration upon making solutions (check once tablets are fully dissolved), and check the concentration frequently to make sure the proper concentration is still present. Change the solution as needed, and use disposable paper towels and discard after wiping down surfaces.

Chemicals shall not be used in any manner that may pose a risk of contamination or a potential health hazard for persons using and/or exposed to the chemical.

findings.citation_text:

Strips were provided during inspection.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.citation_text: 750.810 - All but one spray bottle test at 0-100ppm quat for sanitizer concentration. Sanitizer is prepared at 4th Street location at the wall mounted dispenser and provided as bottles run out of chemical at this location. Owner brought fresh sanitizer during inspection. Bottles were remade at proper concentration (200-400ppm). Staff were advised to consider obtaining sanitizer tablets for use at Rochester and Pleasant Run locations.
